title: Hot days, cold nights
text: Summer days in Paso Robles are hot: at the airport, the average high in July is about 93 degrees. But the nights are much cooler, and across the wine region the gap between a growing-season day's high and that night's low runs from 20 to 50 degrees. The climate is set by the sea in the west and turns more continental, less touched by the ocean, toward the east.
